game_start.intro: Kɛŋ de pɛɛc bɛn. Cɔl de trump: {trump_suit} (kɛt de trump: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
Yin a Wɛr ëbɛn {player_id} ë German Whist.
{phase_info}
Yin rɔ kɛt {hand_size}.
Tɛk kɛt ë '[play N]', hɛre N aye kɛn de yin cɔl (hɛre '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: Kë ye cɔlë 'learning phase' ee kë yenë raan cï tɔŋ bɛ̈n tiaam në kaam de waragɛɛk yiic, ku ka bï kɔc kɔ̈ɔ̈c kek ya dɔm. Ku kä ke cë kaŋ looi thɛɛr këc kënë thök aacïï benëke yök ëke yen wëu ëbɛ̈n lëu bïk keek nyaai.
player_prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: the deck is exhausted. Every trick from now on counts towards victory.

next_card.playing_phase: Acïn kaar ye ke gäm - kë cï bɛ̈n jɔɔk.
next_card.deck_empty: Kä ye kek mat yiic acïn kë tɔ̈ thïn - ka cïn kaar cï gäm ke.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Acie këpuɔth. Luɔ̈I '[play N]' ba athöör ë Nth tɔ̈u yïcin duut yic.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Yïn adhil kë cït kënë looi ku leŋ {lead_suit} kaadi.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Kë cï lueel acie lëu bï looi.

game_action.played: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {player_id} acë bɛ̈n ya gam ke cɔl {card}.

trick.won: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {winner_id} ee wëër në kë de raan cɔl {card}.
trick.won_learning: Wɛr ëbɛn {winner_id} wɛn ë cɔl ëbɛn {card} ë kɛt de ŋɔŋ

phase.learning_complete: Kä ye kek looi acï thök, ku kä cï ke piɔ̈ɔ̈c aacï jal bɛ̈n - kë bï kɔc ya kony në tɔŋ yic.

draw.winner_received: Yïn acï wëu yök ku yïn acë {card} bɛ̈n ya gäm.
draw.loser_received: Yïn acï kä cë ke gɔ̈ɔ̈r nyaai ku yïn acë {card} bɛ̈n cuɛt piny.
